raw_text: Israel is under a massive surprise attack from the Gaza Strip. Hamas launched thousands of rockets and sent fighters across the border into Israeli towns. The IDF has declared a state of war alert. Multiple casualties reported in communities near Gaza. The Re'im music festival near Kibbutz Re'im is reportedly under direct attack with hundreds trapped.
